title: Galinha sem Osso (Boneless Chicken)
description: Prepared with chicken, lamb, and bacon.
steps: Pluck one chicken dry and while still hot, open it along the back and remove all the meat and bones, leaving only the wing tips for when it is to be assembled.
Mince the chicken meat with two arratels of lamb, half of bacon, finely minced aromatics fried in butter.
Take it to the chopping block to season with all seasonings.
Fill the chicken with the minced mixture and eight cooked eggs.
Put it to cook in the bowl on a low flame.
When cooked, season it once more with all seasonings.
Place it in a plate or skillet in which a cheese soup has already been made.
The same is made of young chickens, pigeons, or turkey.

title: Galinhas com arroz para prato de relevo (Chickens with Rice as a Presentation Dish)
description: Prepared with rice, beef broth, and hens.
steps: Wash and dry 1 or 2 arratels of rice
Cook it in broth made with beef, hens, ham, and a piece of lean pork fat with roots and a clove-studded onion
When the rice is cooked and half-cooled, put it in a cassole with egg yolks, grated Parmesan cheese, and a little grated nutmeg
Mix everything and when cooled, make a border two fingers high on the serving plate
Cover the bottom with a little of the same rice
Place whole or quartered hens cooked in a braising liquid with a spoonful of good essence on top
Cover with the rest of the rice and breadcrumbs and grated cheese on top
Sprinkle with butter and cook in the oven
When browned, drain the fat and serve hot. Ducks, young hens, and pigeons are served the same way

title: Galinhas com Arroz à Portuguesa (Chicken with Rice Portuguese Style)
description: Prepared with rice, fat, and ham.

ingredients.name: four arratels of beef from the leg
ingredients.sourceText: four arratels of beef from the leg

steps: Pluck two fat chickens, clean them, truss them, and put them to sweat in a pot with two pieces of ham, four arratels of beef from the leg cut into three or four pieces, one onion studded with cloves, and a sprig of sage
After everything is browned and beginning to stick, add a drop of hot water or broth, and let it boil little by little
When cooked and of good taste, pass the broth through a sieve, add a little vinegar, a sprig of mint and coriander
After boiling, add the quantity of rice necessary so that it remains whole and dry
When thus cooked, arrange the chickens on the plates with the rice on top, garnished with the pieces of ham cut into slices, and serve hot

title: Galinhas com Arroz à Versiana (Chicken with Rice Versiana Style)
description: Prepared with rice, chickens, and broth.

ingredients.name: a little saffron dissolved in a drop of broth
ingredients.sourceText: a little saffron dissolved in a drop of broth

ingredients.name: thin slices of ham cut in cubes
ingredients.sourceText: thin slices of ham cut in cubes

steps: Bone two young chickens, and after cleaning them well, remove all the bones from the neck area
At the same time, put a quarter of rice to cook in a little broth
When the rice is half open, remove it from the fire and add a little melted beef marrow, grated nutmeg, pepper, and a little saffron dissolved in a drop of broth
Take two partridge breasts, cut them into thin slices, cut some slices of ham into cubes, pass them quickly through the fire with melted bacon
Being thus browned, mix them with the rice, and when cool, stuff the chickens with this
After stuffing, sew them with thread or twine, truss them, and then put them to cook in broth with a piece of ham and another of bacon
When half cooked, add half an arratel of well-washed rice, let it boil little by little
When the chickens are finished cooking and the rice is dry, arrange them on the plate and serve them garnished with ham, taking care that the rice grains remain whole
Other times grated cheese can be added on top; and browned in the oven, serve hot as a first course

title: Galinhas e Capões Feitas na Breza para Entradas (Hens and Capons Made in Braise for Starters)
description: Prepared with hens, bacon, and carrots.
steps: Prepare the hens and capons and cook them as is customary, lard them with thick bacon seasoned with salt and pepper.

After finishing larding, line the bottom of a casserole with bacon and veal or beef slices, and place the hens on these with the breast down, season with salt and pepper, one bundle of parsley, fine herbs, carrots, onion studded with cloves.
Cover with other slices of bacon and veal, and paper leaves, and place to cook between coals for a little while.
Moisten with half a spoonful of broth and half a quart of wine, and let simmer gently.
When properly cooked, remove and serve with any vegetable ragú or any other sauce that seems better.
These same hens and capons, if they are young, can be cooked in the same braise without browning.

title: Galinhollas Guisadas para Prato de Entrada (Braised Woodcock for an Entrée)
description: Prepared with woodcock, bacon, and egg yolks.
steps: After plucking and singeing the woodcock, open it along the back to remove the entrails and livers
Chop the livers and add scraped bacon, two egg yolks, parsley, chopped scallion, season with salt and pepper
Stuff the woodcock with this mixture
After stuffing and sewing with thread so the chopped filling does not come out
Turn it upside down with its own beak
Cover with bacon slices and buttered paper
Place to roast
After roasting, remove the paper and bacon
Serve with the sauce or garnish that seems appropriate, such as olives, anchovies, capers, etc.

title: Gateau, ou Bolo de Flor de Laranja (Orange Blossom Cake)
description: A cake made with orange, egg white, and sugar.

ingredients.name: sugar clarified and reduced to hair point
ingredients.sourceText: two pounds of sugar clarified and reduced to hair point

ingredients.name: half a pound of orange blossoms
ingredients.sourceText: half a pound of orange blossoms

steps: Clarified and strained two pounds of sugar reduced to hair point so that these stick to one another, add to it half a pound of orange blossom and allow it to boil until the sugar returns to the same point
Then remove from heat, stir very well with a wooden spoon, both in the middle and on the sides, until the sugar begins to rise

Then add at the same instant a spoonful of fine sugar dissolved in an egg white, and stirring always with haste, pour into paper boxes the height of three fingers, sustaining them on the bottom of the basin so that the heat does not make it fall
Once set and cool, remove them from the molds and serve as desired
Cakes of violet blossoms are also made in the same manner

title: Gaufes (Waffles)
description: Prepared with orange flower water, eggs, and flour.

ingredients.name: a little finely chopped lemon zest
ingredients.sourceText: a little finely chopped lemon zest

ingredients.name: half a quartilho of good milk
ingredients.sourceText: half a quartilho of good milk

steps: Break eggs into a bowl and mix with flour, orange flower water, and lemon zest
After mixing, add half a quartilho of good milk and stir everything with a spoon until the batter is well liquid
Heat the waffle iron on a well-lit brazier
Rub the inside with wax so they do not stick
When the mold is hot, pour a small spoonful of batter inside, close it immediately, and place over the flame
When cooked on one side, flip the iron to finish cooking the other side
Remove carefully and place around a stick of dough so they fold
Store afterwards in a dry place or in a stove for use when needed

title: Gelado de Leite (Frozen Milk Cream)
description: Prepared with milk, egg yolks, and orange or lemon.

ingredients.name: essence such as orange flower, lemon, or bergamot
ingredients.sourceText: essence such as orange flower, lemon, or bergamot

steps: Pour one canada of cow's milk into a pot and let it boil for five or six minutes
Remove from heat and season with one arratel of sugar
Beat in some egg yolks
Pass through a sieve
Place on heat a second time to warm, and when it begins to thicken, remove from heat
Add a few drops of essence, such as orange flower, lemon, or bergamot
When cold, pour into a mold of tin foil
Place this mold inside a bucket with pounded snow, salt, or saltpetre underneath, on top, and all around
When frozen and ready to serve, pass the mold quickly through hot water, and detaching what is inside, turn it carefully onto the plate on which it is to be served, so it may be eaten at that instant

title: Gele (Aspic)
description: Prepared with veal, chicken or hens, and turkey.
steps: Take veal feet, shanks, chicken or old hens, turkey feet, and all glutinous parts according to the quantity of aspic desired
Soak, wash, and blanch them
Cook for three or four hours
When cooked and the broth reduced to the proper consistency, strain through a sieve
Remove all the fat
Season with sugar, lemon juice, cinnamon, and half quartilho of white wine
Bring back to the heat with ten or twelve beaten egg whites
Stir everything, and when it comes to a boil two or three times, add a little cold water
Strain through a cloth until clear
Pour into molds or glasses
Place in a cold place, and when set, serve as is customary

title: Geléa de Maçanis (Apple Jelly)
description: Prepared with apples and sugar.

ingredients.name: sugar clarified and reduced to high point
ingredients.sourceText: sugar clarified and reduced to high point

steps: Take a dozen apples, cut them into quarters, and cook them in water
Once cooked, place them in a cloth, squeeze them very well over an earthenware vessel
Once well squeezed, pour this juice into clarified sugar reduced to high point
Place it to boil again until, placing the skimming spoon in it and raising it in the air and tilting it to one side, the sugar falls in the form of pearls
When it reaches this point, remove from heat, pour into small pots, allow to cool so it keeps better, cover with paper soaked in brandy and another paper on top, and keep in a cool place
In the same manner are made jelly of quinces and of pears

title: Glassa di Carne (Meat Glaze)
description: Prepared with veal, ham, and broth.

ingredients.name: three or four arratels of veal
ingredients.sourceText: three or four arratels of veal

ingredients.name: simple broth, as much as needed
ingredients.sourceText: simple broth, as much as needed

steps: Cut the veal into three or four pieces and place in a bowl with a piece of ham, sear it, add as much simple broth as needed.
Season only with a pinch of salt and fine herbs, and one onion with two or three cloves, and let it simmer little by little.
When the meat is cooked, pass the broth through a sieve.
Return to heat until it reduces, taking care that it does not burn.
When it begins to stick, add half a spoon of broth and stir with a wooden spoon.
When it is dissolved and thickened to the necessary point and with good color, serve for all game dishes, gratins, fillets, and everything desired.

title: Glassa Real (Royal Glaze)
description: Prepared with powdered sugar, egg whites, and orange flower water.

ingredients.name: half an arratel of powdered sugar, sifted and of the finest
ingredients.sourceText: half an arratel of powdered sugar, sifted and of the finest

ingredients.name: some drops of orange flower water
ingredients.sourceText: some drops of orange flower water

steps: Place in a glazed bowl half an arratel of powdered sugar, sifted and of the finest.

Add to it one or two egg whites, some drops of orange flower water, and the juice of one lemon, and dissolving everything with a wooden spoon and well beaten, when it reaches the necessary point and is white as snow, place it carefully on all the dishes where it is necessary.
Put these in a very mild oven, and as soon as the glaze is dry, serve for side dishes.

If eating with oil sauce, serve garnished with parsley sauce around it

title: Jalea de Carne (Meat Jelly)
description: Prepared with chicken, white wine, and egg whites.
steps: Cook a chicken and a dozen sheep feet in enough water so that when well cooked they release the bones
Add half a quart of white wine
When the broth reaches a quantity of one and a half quarts, remove the feet and chicken
Shred them in a cloth and press very well into a pan
Add half arratel of sugar and ten beaten egg whites with the juice of two lemons
Bring to a boil
When boiled, strain through cloth three or four times until the jelly comes out clear (if it is cold, strain between two braziers)
Pour into dishes and when set, send to the table

title: Lagostas Guizadas (Braised Lobsters)
description: Prepared with lobster, chives, and truffles.
steps: Catch the lobsters, tie them with twine, and place in boiling salted water
Cook for half an hour, then remove and let cool
Open them, remove the intestine from the tail, and cut into equal fillets
Brown in butter with sage, chives, and chopped truffles
Add half a quartilho of white wine, half a tablespoon of cullis, a clove of garlic, and a drop of olive oil
Let everything simmer little by little
When the sauce is reduced and of good flavor, serve hot with lemon juice

title: Lampreia Assada (Roasted Lamprey)
description: Prepared with lamprey, wine, and orange juice.
steps: Wash and clean a lamprey in hot water
Remove the teeth, bile, and gills
Make one cut in the middle of the gills and another at the navel so the intestines can be removed without dirtying the inside of the lamprey

Roast it on a spit
Collect the drippings in the same pan
When roasted, season the pan sauce with a splash of wine, juice of one orange, nutmeg, and all seasonings
Serve the sauce apart from the lamprey

description: Prepared with lamprey, wine, and olive oil.
steps: Clean and prepare a lamprey as described above
Put a splash of wine and another of olive oil, vinegar and juice of two sour oranges in a pan

When cooked, serve it on slices

Serve after frying with fried sauce around it

title: Língua de Vacca de Fumo (Smoked Beef Tongue)
description: Prepared with beef tongue and salt.
steps: Prepare in the same manner as pig tongues, with the difference that they should not be blanched, but only placed gently in cold water
Prepare and arrange the thick end of the tongue very well
Once well dried, salt it and leave it for two, three, or four days in salt water
Thread it through the thin point and hang it in the chimney in the smoke so that the smoke penetrates it well and it dries thoroughly
Prepared this way it will keep as long as desired, and cooks in the same manner as the other or pig tongues

description: Prepared with beef tongue, broth, and wine or white wine.

ingredients.name: Champagne wine or other generous white wine
ingredients.sourceText: Champagne wine or other generous white wine

steps: After preparing and skinning the tongue, cook it in broth
Cut into slices and arrange in a casserole with broth, half a quarter-liter of Champagne wine or other generous white wine, and half a spoonful of reduction
Let it boil until little sauce remains
Pour half of this sauce into the bottom of the serving dish, sprinkling Parmesan cheese on top
Arrange the tongue slices on top of this, pour the remaining sauce over them, and cover everything with grated Parmesan
Place to brown in the oven or under the lid of a covered pan
When well browned, serve, first pouring a little clear broth over it

title: Manjar Branco de Gele de Carne (Blanc Mange with Meat Aspic)
description: Prepared with aspic, sweet almonds, and bitter almonds.
steps: Grind in a stone mortar half arratel of sweet almonds and half dozen bitter almonds, moistening from time to time with a little milk

Place on the heat, and when hot, strain with force two or three times through a cloth
Add a little milk to it
Pour into its dish and add some drops of orange flower water
Pass a sheet of white paper over it, and when cold and set, serve for a side dish

description: Prepared with rice flour, hen, and powdered sugar.

ingredients.name: One and a half pounds of powdered sugar
ingredients.sourceText: One and a half pounds of powdered sugar

steps: Dissolve in a pot with one canful of milk five quarters of rice flour, to which add the breast of a half-cooked hen
Having well minced it, season with salt and one and a half pounds of powdered sugar
After everything is mixed and strained through a sieve, place on high heat, stirring always with great speed with a copper spatula
As it thickens, add gradually another canful of milk
When the flour is cooked and at the proper consistency, before it cools, pour into small dishes
Put in the oven to brown, and serve hot or cold, as desired

title: Manjar Real à Portuguesa (Portuguese Royal Blanc Mange)
description: Prepared with hen, bread crumbs, and sweet almonds.
steps: Pluck a hen in hot water, clean it, and wash it, and put it to cook in water with a little salt
When almost cooked, strain the broth through a sieve and remove the fat
Soak the crumb of two vintém pieces of bread in it, and when well soaked, squeeze through cloth
Pour it into a mortar in which there is one arratel of well-ground sweet almonds
Grinding everything again, strain through a sieve, removing the chicken breast
Pour everything into four arratels of sugar at the point of hardening
Bring to gentle heat, stirring always with a spoon until it incorporates to proper consistency
Pour into dishes or small bowls, and serve when it seems good

title: Marmelada (Quince Paste)
description: Prepared with quinces and sugar.
steps: Boil the quinces in water, and when almost cooked, place them in cold water
Once cool, clean them inside, peel them, break them up with a wooden spoon, pass them through a sieve, and take to heat what passed through, stirring always so it does not stick
Once dry, add sugar at the point of thin hair, mix very well with the spoon, take it to heat again, stirring always, and remove from fire once it rises to a boil
Pour into small earthenware pots or covilhetes, allow to cool, cover, and keep for when necessary
In the same manner are made pears, apples, and peaches

title: Massa Folhada (Puff Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with flour, water, and salt.

ingredients.name: Butter, equal amount to the dough
ingredients.sourceText: Butter, equal amount to the dough

steps: Spread on a table one eighth of flour, knead with water and salt, little by little, in such a way that after being bound it is neither soft nor hard
Work it and let it rest for half an hour
Then spread with a rolling pin until it is the thickness of a finger
Spread on top an equal amount of butter as there is dough, roll up very well so that the butter remains enclosed inside
Spread with the rolling pin and continue doing the same three or four times
Finally reduce to the thickness that seems necessary, and it will serve for meat tarts, sweet tarts, small pastries, timbales, fried pastries, and other puff pastry pieces

title: Massa para Brioches e Outros Bolos (Dough for Brioche and Other Buns)
description: A bread preparation made with bread or beer or yeast, water, and flour.

ingredients.name: half an ounce of bread or beer yeast
ingredients.sourceText: half an ounce of bread or beer yeast

steps: Mix the dough with hot water, half an ounce of bread or beer yeast, and half an eighth of flour; when well combined, wrap in cloth and place in a warm location, let it ferment a quarter hour if in summer, or one hour if in winter
Then place on a table with one eighth of flour, eight eggs, {{source-5}}, half an ounce of salt, and a little water, and knead everything together with the palms of the hands two or three times
Dust with flour, wrap again in cloth, and let ferment nine or ten hours
Remove the dough, cut into pieces, shape with the hand, flatten, brush with beaten eggs, place in the oven to bake; if small, bake for half an hour, and if large, one and a half hours
These buns are eaten hot, cold, or as desired

title: Massa para Escalados (Dough for Scalded Dumplings)
description: Prepared with yeast, flour, and butter.

ingredients.name: twelve and a half fresh eggs
ingredients.sourceText: twelve and a half fresh eggs

ingredients.name: three or four ounces of yeast
ingredients.sourceText: three or four ounces of yeast

steps: Place on a table {{source-0}}, half a pound of butter, {{source-2}}, and twelve and a half fresh eggs, and knead everything two or three times with the palm of the hand
Then add three or four ounces of yeast broken into pieces, and knead everything again with the palm of the hand five or six times
Add the dough, dust with flour, and wrap in a towel until the next day
Remove, place on the table, shape into a roll, cut into small pieces, shape on both sides, place in boiling water stirred from time to time with a skimmer so it does not boil over
When the dumplings rise above the water, remove them, place in cold water, then place in a sieve to drain
When necessary, put in the oven to bake, and serve hot or cold as preferred

title: Molejas de Vitella em Espichos (Veal Sweetbreads on Skewers)
description: Prepared with veal sweetbreads, bacon, and shallot.
steps: Cut a piece of lard bacon into small thin and square pieces and put them in a casserole, heat them on the fire
When half cooked, add the sweetbreads also cut into dice and seasoned with salt, pepper, parsley, shallot, little garlic, all well chopped
Turn them several times on the fire, dust with flour, moisten with a spoon of broth, and let it boil
When reduced and with little sauce, thicken it with four egg yolks so it becomes thick and the sauce sticks to the meat
Then put the pieces of sweetbreads on skewers interspersed with pieces of bacon, pass them through the sauce, cover with breadcrumbs, roast them on grills, and serve them dry as an entrance dish

steps: Cut into dice two slices of ham, two roots, and one onion, and two cloves of garlic, and fry everything in melted bacon fat; after frying, add to it one spoonful of broth, another of cullis, one drop of tarragon vinegar, and let it simmer little by little in cooked and reduced broth, remove the fat from it, pass it through a sieve, and serve it for whatever is desired.

title: Molho para Galinholas (Sauce for Woodcocks)
description: A sauce made with sauce, red wine, and bay leaf.

ingredients.name: a little bit of restored sauce
ingredients.sourceText: a little bit of restored sauce

steps: Having roasted two or three woodcocks, remove their breasts and thighs; set aside the livers, and pound the bones, entrails, and livers, after pounding very well, dissolve in red wine and a little bit of restored sauce, and let it simmer seasoned with salt, pepper, and one bay leaf; when reduced, pass it through a sieve, put inside the quarters of woodcocks with fillets and juice of sour oranges; when hot, but not boiling, serve it for ducks, ducklings, snipes, curlews, teals, and other birds, garnished with pieces of fried breadcrumb interior.

description: A sauce made with chervil, purslane, and chives.

title: Molho Verde Picante (Spicy Green Sauce)
description: A sauce made with bacon fat, veal, and white wine.
steps: Fry in melted bacon fat pieces of veal and ham, powdered flour; after frying, add to it {{source-3}}, two spoons of broth, and let it simmer little by little; then pound parsley, chervil, tarragon, mint, chive stems, and squeeze everything with lemon juice, extract the green juice, dissolve it with four egg yolks, bind the sauce with this, pass it through a sieve; and tasting good, serve it for chickens, veal, lamb, kid, and for everything that is tender.

title: Molho à Alemã (German Sauce)

steps: Sauté in butter cooked ham, three cucumbers, small onions, parsley, and one garlic clove, all chopped
After this is sautéed, add one spoonful of broth, season with pepper and one bay leaf
Let it boil gently
When the broth is reduced, bind it with two egg yolks

title: Molho à Almêa para Veado (Almond Sauce for Venison)
description: A sauce made with wine, vinegar, and lemon.

ingredients.name: Cherries or plums cooked in sugar

title: Molho à Bexaméla (Béchamel Sauce)
description: A sauce made with veal, ham, and onion.

ingredients.name: a piece of butter dusted with flour
ingredients.sourceText: a piece of butter dusted with flour

steps: Cut into large pieces some pieces of veal and ham, two roots, and one onion
Pass everything through the fire in a saucepan with melted lard and a piece of butter dusted with flour
Then add broth and reduced beef milk, salt, pepper, one clove of garlic, one onion studded with cloves, fresh herbs
Let it boil gently and slowly
When cooked and reduced, pass it through a sieve
This sauce is used for roasted game fillets, vegetables, and other garnishes

description: A sauce made with broth, egg yolks, and lemon juice.
steps: Pound two lettuces and green parsley in a stone mortar

When reduced, pass through a sieve
Add a piece of butter and three or four chopped egg yolks
When bound and good tasting, serve with lemon juice in the quantity that seems best

title: Molho à Hispanhola (Spanish Sauce)
description: A sauce made with veal, ham, and partridge.

ingredients.name: half a carafe of white wine, already boiled
ingredients.sourceText: half a carafe of white wine, already boiled

steps: Line a pan with slices of veal and slices of ham, add one partridge and two roots
Put on the heat to render its fat gently
When it sticks, add a drop of broth and half a carafe of white wine already boiled
Add one spoonful of meat jelly, season with pepper, coriander seed, garlic cloves, parsley, fine herbs, onion studded with cloves, and good olive oil
Let it boil gently for the space of two hours
Then add two lemon slices and when reduced, remove the fat, pass through a sieve, and it will serve for whatever is necessary

title: Molho à Romanã (Roman Sauce)
description: A sauce made with veal, onions, and white wine.
steps: Guard the substance of a casserole with veal and pork, roots, and onions in rings, and put on the fire to brown little by little

When the substance is browning, add one cup of white wine and two spoonfuls of culls, add capers, four shallots, two cloves of garlic, coriander seed, two lemon rings without skin, season with salt, pepper, and two cloves, and let it cook little by little
When reduced, bind with a little culls, and of good taste, remove the fat, strain through a sieve, and serve for what is necessary

title: Morcellas (Spiced Sausages)
description: Prepared with rye or bread, ground almonds, and butter.

ingredients.name: One and a half arratel of rye bread or grated bread
ingredients.sourceText: One and a half arratel of rye bread or grated bread

ingredients.name: One and a half arratel of fried cow butter
ingredients.sourceText: One and a half arratel of fried cow butter

ingredients.name: Two and a half arratel of clarified sugar
ingredients.sourceText: Two and a half arratel of clarified sugar

ingredients.name: One and a half dozen eggs, beaten with half egg whites
ingredients.sourceText: One and a half dozen eggs, beaten with half egg whites

steps: Put one and a half arratel of rye bread or grated bread in a mortar and pass through a sieve.
Mix with one and a half arratel of fried cow butter and mix very well with a spoon.
Cover it for a bit.
Add one arratel of ground almonds and mix everything together.
Cook with two and a half arratel of clarified sugar, one and a half dozen eggs beaten with half egg whites, seven eighths of pinched clove, a little pepper, and two fingers of cooked salt.
Remove from heat and sprinkle one eighth of pinched cinnamon on top.
Shape the morcellas in straight pig intestine, not too full, and dry them in a reed basket in a place where they do not get smoke.

title: Mãos de Vitela (Veal Hands)
description: Prepared with veal, egg yolks, and broth.
steps: Cook and fry the veal hands
Bread them with eggs and place them on a soup called Joldresi
To make this soup, beat six raw egg yolks in a pan with one arratel of butter, two spoonfuls of broth, quarter pound of sugar, a bit of vinegar, pepper, nutmeg, and salt
Put all this over the fire and when it begins to boil, which is the sign it is done, put the breaded veal hands inside
Place them in a small pot on coals so it does not break and on bread slices send to the table

title: Noz de Vitella de Fricandó com Ragú Branco de Chicórias (Veal Sweetbread Fricandeau with White Chicory Ragout)
description: Prepared with veal, onions, and melted butter.
steps: Take one veal sweetbread, prepare it, trim it, lard it, and finish it with its glaze as described in the previous recipes
Take two chicories, blanch them in hot water
Cut two onions into fillets and pass them through a casserole with melted butter
After passing them, dust them with flour and add a spoonful of stock
Cut the chicories into pieces and add them to the onion fillets
Season with a little salt and pepper, and once cooked and of good taste, remove the fat and bind with egg yolks dissolved in cream and milk
Alternatively, after the chicories are blanched, squeeze them and tie them with string and cook them, then cut into equal pieces

title: Noz de Vitella em Caixa com Hervas Finas (Veal Sweetbread in Paper with Fine Herbs)
description: Prepared with veal or sweetbread, bacon or olive oil, and truffles.

ingredients.name: one veal sweetbread or other piece of leg
ingredients.sourceText: one veal sweetbread or other piece of leg

steps: Trim the veal sweetbread or any other piece of leg, beat it between two cloths with the flat of a knife
Marinate it afterwards in melted bacon or a little olive oil with salt, pepper, parsley, truffles, shallots, and cucumbers all finely minced
Remove it from the marinade, place it in a paper box lined with butter, and place it to roast on top of a grill over another buttered paper with gentle fire, taking care not to burn the paper
Once roasted in this way on both sides, it will be served in its same box with lemon juice or with a splash of white vinegar

If the veal sweetbreads are small and tender, being very well trimmed and beaten between two cloths, marinate them as above, adding some bay leaf, and roasted also in a box, remove them and serve on a plate with good sauce and lemon juice

steps: Take one loin of veal well mortified and very pale, and clean it well of its skins as if for fricassee.
Cut lengthwise into very thin slices, which you will flatten well with a knife.
Once thus prepared and well equal, place on top of each a little minced meat the size of a five-reis coin, which you will unite well with the flat of the knife wetted in beaten eggs.
Roll these slices very tightly and well closed, and wrap them in bacon slices of the same size, and fasten them with skewers so they cook on the spit covered with paper.
Once cooked, remove the paper and bacon, brush them with fresh butter corrected and prepared with fine bread crumbs, give them good color.
Serve them on a plate with Spanish sauce underneath or an essence with lemon juice, and serve hot as an appetizer.

description: Prepared with veal, chives, and cucumbers.

ingredients.name: one or two loins of veal
ingredients.sourceText: one or two loins of veal

ingredients.name: half a quarter-liter of good oil
ingredients.sourceText: half a quarter-liter of good oil

steps: Take one or two loins of veal, prepare them and cut them as the above, marinate them in a saucepan with salt, pepper, parsley, chives, one clove of garlic, fine herbs, cucumbers and truffles, all chopped fine, half a quarter-liter of good oil and lemon juice.
After marinating for some time, place on top a little raw minced meat, well bound, and in such form that it remains well closed.
After rolling the slices, tie them with twine.
Line a saucepan with bacon slices, veal, ham, and onion rounds; arrange the roulades on top and cover them in the same manner as you prepared the base below.
Put them to cook over low heat: when cooked, transfer them to another saucepan, and pour into the saucepan in which they cooked a little substance and a little cullis, and put it to simmer.
Once the sauce is reduced and of good taste, strain it through a sieve and pour it over the roulades, and keep them well heated until serving.
They can also be served with truffle sauce, capers, and sorrel, all very finely chopped, or with Italian sauce.

title: Olha Podrida em Massa (Layered Meat Pie in Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with beef, pork, and chickens.

ingredients.name: Two loaves of ten réis bread
ingredients.sourceText: Two loaves of ten réis bread

steps: Brown all the meats and vegetables in chopped bacon, each item separately
When all are browned and half-cooked in bacon, knead one alqueire of flour with butter and eggs, removing two eggs' worth of dough
Place one portion of dough with paper underneath on a baking sheet
Arrange two loaves of ten réis bread as a base, topped with sliced beef breast, then arrange the aforementioned meats and vegetables in good order on top
Cover with another layer of dough, extending it to cover everything, and make the rim very thick so it does not burst
Make an opening on top to pour in the liquid left from browning the meats
Make two dough handles as on a panela and a worked top crust
Place in an oven to roast slowly
When serving, drain it and remove the sauce

description: A soup made with veal, ham, and onions.

steps: Put three or four arratels of veal, half an arratel of ham, two onions in slices, two roots in a casserole
When it sticks, add a little melted bacon fat and a little flour, and stirring always until it takes color, add three or four spoons of stock and three or four spoons of substance
Season with salt, pepper, two cloves, one bundle of parsley and fine herbs, some slices of truffles, and some mushrooms
Let it simmer little by little
When everything is cooked, add some pieces of bread and two dressed and pounded partridges
Pass through a strainer and when warm and without boiling, use for everything that is necessary
In place of partridges you may use chickens, capons, woodcocks, ducks, wild pigeons, quails, and rabbits, whatever you prefer

title: Outro Presunto para uma Entrada (Another Ham for an Appetizer)
description: Prepared with ham, veal, and bacon.

ingredients.name: uma cabeça de alhos (one head of garlic)
ingredients.sourceText: uma cabeça de alhos (one head of garlic)

ingredients.name: ragú de espinafres à crema (spinach ragout with cream)
ingredients.sourceText: ragú de espinafres à crema (spinach ragout with cream)

steps: Take a good ham, trim it, remove the bones from the inside through the bottom
Soak it for two or three days, and after removing the salt, put it to boil for half an hour in water
After it is set, line the bottom of a pan with slices of veal and bacon, a layer of parsley, fine herbs, a clove-studded onion, some roots, and one head of garlic
Cover it with other slices of veal and bacon, and put it to cook gently between two fires for ten or twelve hours
When cooked, serve it with spinach ragout with cream well made

Alternatively, after removing the ham, the veal slices can be moistened with a spoonful of broth, and after boiling a little, this broth can be strained through a sieve, the fat removed, and reduced to a glaze consistency; and when the ham is browned in it, serve it with the same sauce or with vegetable ragout, whichever seems better

description: Prepared with eggs, bread, and grated cheese.
steps: Cook eggs hard and place in cold water, shell them, cut lengthwise in two halves, remove the yolks and pound them in a mortar with bread soaked in milk, a piece of fresh butter, grated cheese, chopped parsley, salt, pepper, and ground nutmeg

When browned, serve hot as an entrée

steps: Put in a casserole a little butter, the crumb of two or three vintens of bread, and half a canada of very hot milk over the bread

Add twelve or fifteen egg yolks with the same number of egg whites beaten separately

Put in an oven with moderate heat

title: Pasteis Communs (Common Meat Pastries)
description: A pastry dish made with mutton, bacon, and broth.

ingredients.name: Two arratels of mutton, finely chopped
ingredients.sourceText: Two arratels of mutton, finely chopped

steps: Brown the finely chopped mutton with one quarter chopped bacon and aromatics, adding one spoon of broth
When half-cooked, season with vinegar and cook with all ground seasonings
Thicken with three beaten egg yolks and let cool
Toast one eighth of flour with one quarter of sugar, half an arratel of butter, and two egg yolks, kneading the dough very well
Shape pastries in boxes of desired size and fill with the meat
Cook them
When serving, dissolve one egg yolk in one spoon of broth with lemon juice and put a small amount of this sauce through a hole in each pastry so the meat becomes more tender

title: Pastel de uma Perna de Carneiro (Pie of One Leg of Lamb)
description: A pastry dish made with leg of lamb, bacon, and onions.

ingredients.name: About half a dozen beaten eggs
ingredients.sourceText: About half a dozen beaten eggs

steps: Put into a pot one leg of lamb, half an arratel of bacon, {{source-2}}, two onions, a splash of vinegar, whole seasonings, and a bundle of all aromatics.
Cook in little water until the lamb is more than half cooked.
Remove it and mince all the lamb separately, and likewise mince the aromatics separately.
In a shallow bowl buttered, layer lamb, layer of bacon, and layer of aromatics until all is finished.
Pour about half a dozen beaten eggs over the top and put it to brown on a low flame.
When done, make some sops of the said substance outside and after they are well soaked, turn the bowl onto the plate, and break the bowl so that the sop remains whole.
Place the pie on top, pour lemon juice over it, and send it to the table.
This can also be made with loins and veal, or whatever meat you wish.

title: Pastelilhos Brancos (White Pastries)
description: A pastry dish made with chicken breast, beef fat, and lard.
steps: Make a chopped mixture of chicken breast, beef fat, lard, and cooked veal udders
After chopping, pound in a mortar
Season with salt, pepper, parsley, chopped chives
Bind with a piece of bread soaked in milk and four egg yolks
Form small boxes of dough the size of a new silver crusado and the height of two fingers
Fill with the chopped mixture
Cover with another small piece of dough
Cook in the oven
Once cooked, remove all the chopped mixture from inside
Dissolve in a little broth, egg yolks, milk, and lemon juice
Once bound, place back in the forms
Serve hot

title: Paõ de Vitella (Veal Loaf)
description: Prepared with veal, bacon, and ham.
steps: Cook a veal leg and reserve the best part
Remove the nerves and skin well from the remainder and make a forcemeat with bacon and ham, seasoned with salt, pepper, fine herbs, and one clove of garlic
Take the best part of the veal, a piece of ham, and bacon
Cut everything in dice and combine with the forcemeat
Add four egg yolks
Line a casserole with bacon slices, arrange everything inside, and cook in a moderate oven
Once cooked, let it cool to serve sliced
Other times you may add pistachios and sweet almonds cut in small dice and serve with a napkin underneath
It can also be served hot with Spanish sauce

title: Peito de Vacca à Alemoa (Beef Brisket German Style)
description: Prepared with beef, broth, and sausage.

ingredients.name: Six or eight arratels of beef brisket
ingredients.sourceText: Six or eight arratels of beef brisket

ingredients.name: six or eight quarters of cabbage
ingredients.sourceText: six or eight quarters of cabbage

steps: Take six or eight arratels of beef brisket and after cutting into seven or eight equal parts, well trimmed, and soaked, blanch in boiling water
Place to cook in broth with a bundle of sausage, chives, two cloves of garlic, thyme, and one bay leaf
When half-cooked, add six or eight quarters of cabbage, which are also first blanched and squeezed, well tied, with seven or eight whole onions, everything seasoned with little salt and whole pepper
When everything is almost cooked, add a dozen whole sausages
When everything is finished cooking, remove the meat and vegetables and place to drain

title: Peitos de Vitella por diferentes modos (Veal Breast in Different Ways)
description: Prepared with veal, ham, and broth.
steps: Parboil the veal breasts and soak them in water for some time, blanch them, and cut them into equal pieces
Pass them through the fire with a piece of butter, a slice of ham, a bouquet garnish with little salt and pepper, and dust with flour
Moisten with broth and hot water
When cooked, remove the bouquet and fat, thicken with four egg yolks mixed in milk, and serve with verjuice or apple juice
They can also be made with green peas and thickened with egg yolks as above
If not, after being sautéed, moisten them with stock and a little broth
They can also be larded as one does with fricandeau and finished the same way, and served with a ragout of asparagus tips, peas, sorrel, or any other vegetable garnish
These pieces of veal breast after being cooked in a braise can be served in terrines garnished with cabbage and pieces of intermingled lardoon, or with any other ragout that seems best

steps: Take a small piece of butter in a bowl and melt it in gentle heat

title: Peixe Inteiro Assado, Cozido, e Frito (Whole Fish Roasted, Boiled, and Fried)
description: Prepared with fish and water.
steps: Divide the fish into three parts with two cuts, leaving the head as one part, the middle as another, and the tail as another
Hold it by the head and tail, fry the middle part, and turning it in the same manner, fry it on the other side
After the middle is fried, roast the tail on a grill on both sides
When roasted, wrap the cold and roasted part in paper, and holding it with your hands, boil the head in a pot of boiling water

Place the fish on a plate on top of a pastry without a lid, and make three small boxes inside, putting hot sauce for roasted in one, cold sauce for boiled in another, and escabeche for the cold part in the third
When done, send it to the table

title: Pelotas de Nozes de Vitella (Veal Loin Balls)
description: Prepared with veal, bacon, and oil or bacon.

ingredients.name: one or two loins of veal
ingredients.sourceText: one or two loins of veal

steps: Take one or two loins of veal well trimmed so they remain round, cut them across their entire width into three or four pieces, which you will flatten very well between two cloths with the flat of a knife.
Lard them afterward with fine bacon, and once larded, marinate them in a little oil, or in place of this, melted bacon, with salt, pepper, onions, lemon slices, and bay leaves.
At the same time marinate the pieces that are trimmed from around the loins with some chicken or turkey breasts, veal meatballs, and thin slices of ham.

After marinating everything for some time, place the veal on a washed cloth with the larding facing down, and arrange on top the slices, meatballs, breasts, etc., and cook everything around as a ball, and thus closed put them to cook in a saucepan with bacon slices, veal, ham, onion rounds, and thus covered above and below, cook them over low heat.

Once cooked and of good color, remove the balls, and adding a spoonful of cullis to what remained at the bottom of the saucepan, put it to simmer, and reduced and of good taste, remove the fat, and serve them hot with lemon juice.
If they do not have good color, they can be glazed afterward, as we have already said.

title: Perna de Carneiro Armada (Armed Leg of Lamb)
description: Prepared with leg of lamb, bacon, and bread crumbs.
steps: Mince all the meat from a leg of lamb with half an arratel of bacon and aromatics, being careful to leave the bone of the leg whole.
Temper the meat on the chopping block with all the seasonings, three eggs, bread crumbs, vinegar, and lemon juice.
In a buttered skillet large enough to hold it, begin assembling the leg so that it appears whole, composing it with its bacon lards, cooked egg yolk, and blanched almonds.
Put it to cook on a low flame.
When cooked, strain the substance with two egg yolks and place it on the plate with slices of bread underneath, lemon juice and cinnamon on top.

title: Peros de Conserva para o Inverno (Preserved Pears for Winter)
description: Prepared with pears, water, and sugar.
steps: Clean the pears very well, cut off the tip of the stem, and scrape the rest
Put them in water and cook in boiling water until they are soft to the touch when pressed between the fingers
Remove with a skimmer and place in cold water, then drain
Soak for two hours in water with dissolved sugar
Arrange on perforated trays with the stem end facing up
Place in a mild oven and leave overnight
Remove in the morning and soak again in sugar water
Return to the oven in the same way and continue this process for four or five days
The last time they should be completely dry, then store in a dry and airy place for as long as necessary

title: Peru Assado à Italiana (Turkey Roasted Italian Style for an Appetizer)
description: Prepared with turkey, chicken, and lemon.
steps: Clean one turkey and fill it inside with a mince made of chicken livers as previously described
Straighten it, tie it with twine, and put it to blanch over heat in a casserole with pork butter, lemon slices, parsley, and marjoram whole, and leave it so it remains very white
Once blanched, let it cool, and when cold, place it on the spit covered with bacon strips and paper, and put it to roast

Afterwards take a little parsley, small onions, tarragon, sorrel, and blanch everything in hot water, squeeze it very well afterwards, chop everything very fine, put what is necessary in a casserole with four egg yolks, half a cup of white wine, a little good olive oil, a pair of anchovies, a pair of capers, all well chopped, salt, pepper, and a little cullis, and put it over the heat with two lemon slices without skin, and stir always around with a wooden spoon, taking care that it does not curdle
Once bound and of good taste, and the turkey roasted, remove the paper and bacon, place it and arrange it on its platter with the aforementioned sauce on top, and serve hot

ingredients.name: turkey gizzards, truffles, livers, or other choice ingredients
ingredients.sourceText: turkey gizzards, truffles, livers, or other choice ingredients

steps: Prepare and pluck the turkeys, place them on a spit covered with bacon strips and paper sheets on top
Roast them
Meanwhile, make a fine mince of veal pieces, bacon, and beef fat, all chopped and cut into small pieces, and pass them over moderate heat seasoned with salt, pepper, shallot, and fine herbs
Once the turkeys are roasted and cooled, remove the breast meat, mix it with the mince, chop it on the table, and pound it very well in a mortar
Add to it a bread crumb soaked in milk but cooled, and bind it with six egg yolks and egg whites beaten until stiff

Place the turkeys in a baking dish with bacon strips underneath, fill the place where the breasts were removed with the prepared mixture, placing in the middle a ragout of turkey gizzards, truffles, livers, or any other choice ingredient, as long as it is cold and well bound
Cover it with the rest of the mince, seal it with beaten eggs and the back of a knife blade so it appears whole, cover it afterwards with finely grated bread crumb, and put it to cook in the oven
Once cooked and browned, serve with good essence or Spanish sauce

title: Peru à Crema Assado (Roasted Turkey with Cream Sauce)
description: A sauce made with turkey, bacon, and ham.

ingredients.name: half a Canada of hot milk
ingredients.sourceText: half a Canada of hot milk

steps: After the turkey is prepared, singed, and straightened as is customary, blanch it in a furnace, tie it with twine, and lard it with bacon and ham of medium thickness
After larding, soak it in a casserole with half a Canada of hot milk, a piece of butter, fine herbs, dried coriander, salt, pepper, and onion slices
After marinating for three or four hours, place it on the spit covered with bacon strips and paper sheets
When half roasted, remove the paper and bacon, baste it with its marinade
Then thicken this marinade with a little milk, two egg yolks, a piece of butter, flour, and salt
Once thickened, gradually pour it over the turkey little by little so that a crust forms over it and takes on a good golden color
When roasting is finished, remove it and serve with a peppery sauce underneath or with any other piquant sauce that seems fitting

title: Peru à Montmorency (Turkey à Montmorency)
description: Prepared with turkey, bacon, and forcemeat.

ingredients.name: ragú of small birds or calf sweetbreads
ingredients.sourceText: ragú of small birds or calf sweetbreads

steps: Prepare and clean a young turkey, open it along the back
Remove the carcass up to the croup and the large breast bones
Tuck the legs inside and fill with a slice of bacon and some paper leaves
Sew it back along the back as if it were whole, tie it, and put it to blanch in lard
After blanching, lard it with finely minced bacon
Remove the paper and the bacon inside, and stuff it with good forcemeat and a ragú of small birds or calf sweetbreads, truffles, and mushrooms in the middle
Sew it closed with twine, pass it with skewers, and put it to roast on the spit covered with paper leaves
When roasted and of good color, serve with clear essence of good taste and lemon juice

title: Peru à Princeza para huma Entrada (Turkey à la Princesse for an Entrée)
description: Prepared with turkey, breadcrumbs, and lard.
steps: Prepare and clean the turkey, cut it in half, beat it between two cloths
Remove the larger bones and put it to cook in a good broth
Once cooked and cold, trim it, cover it with fine grated bread as is customary, and fry it in lard
When fried and colored, serve hot with remoulade sauce made with egg yolks, capers, parsley, and other condiments as described in the section on sauces
Alternatively, it can be grilled and served with the same sauce or with another spicy sauce

Cut the turkey into pieces and place on slices
Pour the sauce over with the fruit quarters and lemon
Serve to the table

description: A soup made with turkey, garlic, and vinegar.

ingredients.name: one small piece of good butter
ingredients.sourceText: one small piece of good butter

steps: Roast the turkey in an oven in a pan with a small piece of good butter, seasonings, one garlic clove, a measure of vinegar, and a measure of water

Add one quarter of ground almonds and bring to a boil
Season with black spices
Carve the turkey and place on slices
Pour the sauce over with lemon juice
Serve to the table

title: Perum Salsichado (Sausage-Styled Turkey)
description: Prepared with turkey, bread, and lard.

ingredients.name: lard, thick and seasoned with salt and pepper
ingredients.sourceText: lard, thick and seasoned with salt and pepper

ingredients.name: all seasonings whole and ground (except saffron)
ingredients.sourceText: all seasonings whole and ground (except saffron)

steps: Grind the turkey with the bread
Blanch it in a pot with water and salt
Lard it first with thick, seasoned lard
Place in a pot with diced bacon, six sour apples, all seasonings whole and ground (except saffron), a measure of wine, little vinegar, and one quartilho of water
Seal the pot so steam does not escape
Place in the oven for three hours, or surround with embers around the fire for four hours, turning the pot frequently
When done, place on a plate over slices with lemon juice on top, or verjuice if available

description: Prepared with turkey, bacon, and mutton.
steps: Take one turkey and braise it in quarters in one arratel of bacon

title: Perú à Cardeal para huma Entrada (Turkey Cardinal Style for an Entree)
description: Prepared with turkey, chives, and truffles.
steps: Take a mortified young turkey or hen turkey for two or three days
Stuff it with a forcemeat made from its own livers, parsley, chives, truffles, mushrooms, seasoned with salt, pepper, and scraped bacon, bound with two egg yolks
Tie the turkey leaving the legs extended
Gently separate the skin on the breast without breaking it
Fill it with butter colored with crushed shrimp shells to give it color
Secure the skin at the wing tips
Roast on a spit covered with bacon strips and paper leaves
When roasted, remove the paper and string, and serve with shrimp cullis sauce and other sauces

title: Perú à Provençala para huma Entrada (Turkey Provençale Style for an Entree)
description: Prepared with turkey, fat, and veal sweetbreads.
steps: Prepare and mortify a tender turkey hen
Place it on a spit covered with bacon strips and paper leaves
While it roasts, make a stew of fat livers and veal sweetbreads that are passed through the fire in melted bacon with a little flour
Moisten with a quart of white wine, a little broth, and a herb bundle, seasoned with little salt and pepper
When reduced and of good taste, add chopped roe, capers, and pitted olives
Finish binding with a little cullis and remove the fat
Remove the turkey hen from the spit, place on its plate, and serve with its ragout on top and lemon juice

title: Perúa Nova com Enxovas para huma Entrada (Young Turkey Hen with Roe for an Entree)
description: Prepared with turkey, roe, and bacon.
steps: After preparing the turkey hen, stuff it with a forcemeat made from its own livers, scraped bacon, three roe, parsley, chives, truffles, all finely chopped and pounded in a mortar, bound with two egg yolks, and seasoned with little salt and pepper

Sear it in pork butter and after cooling and cleaning well, cover it with bacon strips and paper leaves
Place to roast as is customary
After roasting, remove the bacon strips and paper leaves, place on its plate, and serve with ham essence sauce, one roe dissolved inside, juice and lemon fillets

title: Pessegos Seccos (Dried Peaches)
description: Prepared with peaches and sugar.

ingredients.name: peaches (not small, not soft, very dry)
ingredients.sourceText: peaches (not small, not soft, very dry)

steps: Clean the peaches in a sieve
Select those that are not small nor soft
Dry them very well
Remove the pits with an iron tool that runs around like expelling the pit
Replace it in the peach after doing this to all
Keep them four days in sugar at ribbon point, giving it one boiling each day
On the last boiling remove them from the sugar to take out the pits
Cover them with the same sugar which should be at the proper point
Drain them on a grate or sieve
Place them on a tray to dry in the sun so cold does not strike them
When keeping them after being well dried, place them in linen cloth so they do not dampen

description: Prepared with veal, breadcrumbs, and egg yolks.
steps: After the veal tenderloins have been roasted on the spit

title: Pombinhos de Compota com molho branco (Young Pigeons in White Sauce)
description: A sauce made with pigeons, onion, and ham.
steps: Take half a dozen young pigeons, blanch them, empty them, straighten them, and tuck the feet inside the body
Stiffen them in hot water, then place them in a casserole with butter, clove-studded onion, a sprig of parsley, and a piece of ham
Pass everything over the fire for a brief moment, dust them with flour, add a little broth, season with salt and pepper
When cooked, remove the fat, parsley, and onion, thicken the broth with egg yolks dissolved in milk
When thickened, serve hot with lemon juice

description: A sauce made with pigeons, bacon, and ham.
steps: After cleaning the pigeons and tucking the feet inside, brown them over the fire with rendered bacon or butter, a slice of ham, a sprig of parsley, and fine herbs

Let simmer slowly and gently until cooked, reduce the sauce, remove all fat, finish thickening with a little cullis

steps: Take half a dozen young pigeons, prepare them the same way as the preceding recipes, but using olive oil instead of butter

title: Pombinhos em Conchas com Queijo Parmesão (Young Pigeons in Shells with Parmesan Cheese)
description: Prepared with pigeons, parmesan cheese, and sweetbreads.
steps: Take six young pigeons and after preparing and straightening them, place in a casserole with fresh butter, sweetbreads, truffles, and ham, all cut into small dice
Pass through the fire, then moisten with stock and thicken with a little veal coulis
When cooked and the sauce is reduced, put a little grated Parmesan cheese in the bottom of the shell
Place the pigeon on top with its garnish and a little sauce, with grated cheese on top
When finished this way, put in the oven to glaze and serve hot

title: Pombos assados nas grelhas (Grilled Young Pigeons)
description: Prepared with fat, onion, and olive oil.
steps: Take four large fat young pigeons, clean and singe them, tuck the legs inside, split them down the back or breast
Pound them between cloths with the knife blade
Season with salt, pepper, parsley, minced onion, good olive oil, bay leaf, and marjoram
Let sit for two or three hours to absorb the flavors
Dust with fine breadcrumbs and grill over coals, basting with the marinade
When grilled and of good color, serve with shallot sauce or spicy sauce

title: Pombos Enredados (Bacon-wrapped Squabs)
description: Prepared with squabs, bacon, and puff pastry.
steps: Wrap two whole squabs in bacon and season with seasonings, then roast them on a spit
When they are browned, cover each one with a piece of Portuguese puff pastry
Wrap them in a sheet of paper and tie with string, then roast again on the spit until the pastry is cooked
Remove the paper and send to the table hot
